name: D&D 5e (2014 Ruleset)
description: Standard 5th Edition SRD 5.1 ruleset with 2014 character options, races, classes, and condition rules.

attribution.notice: Designation of Open Game Content: The entire SRD 5.1 is Open Game Content released under CC-BY-4.0.

conditions.name: Blinded
conditions.description: Cannot see, fails checks requiring sight. Attack rolls against have advantage, attacks have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Charmed
conditions.description: Cannot harm charmer; charmer has advantage on social ability checks.

conditions.name: Deafened
conditions.description: Cannot hear, fails checks requiring hearing.

conditions.name: Frightened
conditions.description: Disadvantage on ability checks/attacks while source in line of sight; cannot willingly move closer.

conditions.name: Invisible
conditions.description: Impossible to see without magic; attacks have advantage, attacks against have disadvantage.

conditions.name: Paralyzed
conditions.description: Incapacitated, cannot move or speak. Automatically fails Str and Dex saves. Attacks against have advantage, critical within 5ft.

conditions.name: Petrified
conditions.description: Transformed into solid substance. Incapacitated, unaware of surroundings, weight increases x10.

conditions.name: Poisoned
conditions.description: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

conditions.name: Prone
conditions.description: Must crawl (costs double movement). Disadvantage on attack rolls. Attacks against within 5ft have advantage.

conditions.name: Restrained
conditions.description: Speed becomes 0. Attacks against have advantage, attacks have disadvantage. Disadvantage on Dex saves.

conditions.name: Stunned
conditions.description: Incapacitated, cannot move, can only speak falteringly. Automatically fails Str and Dex saves. Attacks against have advantage.

conditions.name: Unconscious
conditions.description: Incapacitated, cannot move or speak, unaware. Drops whatever holding, falls prone. Automatically fails Str and Dex saves.

actions.name: Attack
actions.description: Make one melee or ranged weapon attack.

actions.name: Cast a Spell
actions.description: Cast a cantrip or spell with a casting time of 1 action.

actions.name: Dash
actions.description: Gain extra movement equal to your speed for the current turn.

actions.name: Disengage
actions.description: Your movement doesn't provoke opportunity attacks for the rest of the turn.

actions.name: Dodge
actions.description: Focus entirely on avoiding attacks. Attackers have disadvantage if you can see them, and you have advantage on Dex saves.

actions.name: Help
actions.description: Lend aid to an ally, granting advantage on their next ability check or attack roll.

actions.name: Hide
actions.description: Make a Dexterity (Stealth) check in an attempt to become hidden.

actions.name: Ready
actions.description: Wait for a particular circumstance before you act, taking a reaction when the trigger occurs.

actions.name: Search
actions.description: Devote your attention to finding something with a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check.

actions.name: Use an Object
actions.description: Interact with an object or item that requires your full action.

actions.name: Opportunity Attack
actions.description: Make one melee attack against a hostile creature that moves out of your reach.

races.name: Human
races.description: Versatile and ambitious, humans are the most adaptable and diverse people.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Magical people of otherworldly grace, living in the world but not entirely part of it.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 ft).

features.name: Keen Senses
features.description: Proficiency in the Perception skill.

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Advantage on saves vs being charmed, and magic cannot put you to sleep.

features.name: Trance
features.description: Elves meditate deeply for 4 hours instead of sleeping.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Bold and hardy, dwarves are known as skilled warriors, miners, and workers of stone and metal.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Accustomed to life underground, you see in darkness (60 ft).

features.name: Dwarven Resilience
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against poison, and resistance against poison damage.

races.name: Halfling
races.description: Small and practical survivors who survive through stealth and good cheer.

features.name: Lucky
features.description: When you roll a 1 on d20 for attack, check, or save, you can reroll.

features.name: Brave
features.description: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

races.name: Dragonborn
races.description: Born of dragons, walking proudly through a world that greets them with fearful incomprehension.

features.name: Draconic Ancestry
features.description: Choose a dragon type determining your breath weapon and damage resistance.

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.description: Exhale destructive energy in a 15ft cone or 30ft line once per rest.

races.name: Gnome
races.description: A constant hum of busy activity pervades the warrens where gnomes live.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 ft).

features.name: Gnome Cunning
features.description: Advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saves against magic.

races.name: Half-Elf
races.description: Walking in two worlds but truly belonging to neither.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 ft).

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.description: Advantage on saves vs being charmed; magic cannot sleep you.

features.name: Skill Versatility
features.description: Gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.

races.name: Half-Orc
races.description: Whether united under leadership or fighting for survival, half-orcs show savage fury.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 ft).

features.name: Relentless Endurance
features.description: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead once per long rest.

features.name: Savage Attacks
features.description: When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon, roll one of the weapon's damage dice one additional time.

races.name: Tiefling
races.description: Infused with the essence of Asmodeus—overlord of the Nine Hells.

features.name: Darkvision
features.description: Superior vision in dark and dim conditions (60 ft).

features.name: Hellish Resistance
features.description: Resistance to fire damage.

features.name: Infernal Legacy
features.description: You know Thaumaturgy cantrip; cast Hellish Rebuke at 3rd level, Darkness at 5th level.

races.name: Fairy
races.description: Infused with Feywild magic, resembling small winged elves with flight and nature cantrips.

features.name: Flight
features.description: Flying speed equal to walking speed (30 ft). Cannot fly if wearing medium or heavy armor.

features.name: Fairy Magic
features.description: You know Druidcraft; cast Faerie Fire at 3rd level, Enlarge/Reduce at 5th level.

races.name: Harengon
races.description: Rabbitfolk native to the Feywild, energetic and lucky travelers.

features.name: Hare-Trigger
features.description: Add proficiency bonus to initiative rolls.

features.name: Rabbit Hop
features.description: Bonus action jump 5 × proficiency bonus feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

classes.name: Barbarian
classes.description: A fierce warrior of primitive background who can enter a battle rage.

features.name: Rage
features.description: In battle, you fight with primal ferocity for 1 minute, gaining advantage on Strength checks and saves, bonus melee damage, and resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor, your AC equals 10 + Dex modifier + Con modifier (you can use a shield).

features.name: Reckless Attack
features.description: Gain advantage on melee weapon attack rolls using Strength during your turn, but attacks against you have advantage until your next turn.

subclasses.name: Path of the Berserker
subclasses.description: Channels violent fury into a bloodthirsty frenzy.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: An inspiring magician whose power echoes the music of creation.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.description: Use a bonus action to give an ally a d6 inspiration die to add to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.description: Add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to any ability check that doesn't already include it.

subclasses.name: College of Lore
subclasses.description: Pursuers of beauty, truth, and ancient secrets.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: A priestly champion who wields divine magic in service of a higher power.

features.name: Divine Domain
features.description: Choose a domain related to your deity, such as Life Domain, granting bonus domain spells and features.

subclasses.name: Life Domain
subclasses.description: Focuses on preserving life and restoring vitality.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: A priest of the Old Faith, wielding the powers of nature and adopting animal forms.

features.name: Druidic
features.description: You know Druidic, the secret language of druids.

features.name: Wild Shape
features.description: Use an action to magically assume the shape of a beast you have seen before.

subclasses.name: Circle of the Land
subclasses.description: Mystics and sages who safeguard ancient nature lore.

classes.name: Fighter
classes.description: A master of martial combat, skilled with a variety of weapons and armor.

features.name: Second Wind
features.description: Regain hit points equal to 1d10 + your fighter level as a bonus action once per rest.

features.name: Action Surge
features.description: Take one additional action on your turn once per short or long rest.

subclasses.name: Champion
subclasses.description: Focuses on raw physical power honed to deadly perfection.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: A master of martial arts, harnessing the power of the body in pursuit of physical and spiritual perfection.

features.name: Unarmored Defense
features.description: While not wearing armor and not wielding a shield, your AC equals 10 + Dex modifier + Wis modifier.

features.name: Martial Arts
features.description: Use Dex instead of Str for unarmed strikes and monk weapons, roll d4 for unarmed strikes, and make bonus unarmed attacks.

features.name: Ki
features.description: Harness ki energy to fuel Flurry of Blows, Patient Defense, and Step of the Wind.

subclasses.name: Way of the Open Hand
subclasses.description: Masters of unarmed martial combat techniques.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: A holy warrior bound to a sacred oath.

features.name: Divine Sense
features.description: Detect the presence of celestials, fiends, and undead within 60 feet.

features.name: Lay on Hands
features.description: Heal creatures from a pool of healing power equal to your paladin level × 5.

features.name: Divine Smite
features.description: Expend a spell slot to deal 2d8 radiant damage on a melee weapon hit (+1d8 per slot level above 1st).

subclasses.name: Oath of Devotion
subclasses.description: Upholds the ideals of justice, virtue, and order.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: A warrior who uses martial prowess and nature magic to combat threats on the edges of civilization.

features.name: Favored Enemy
features.description: Gain advantage on survival and knowledge checks against your favored enemy type.

features.name: Natural Explorer
features.description: Difficult terrain doesn't slow your group's travel in favored terrain.

subclasses.name: Hunter
subclasses.description: Emulates the specialized tactics of apex wilderness predators.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: A scoundrel who uses stealth and trickery to overcome obstacles and enemies.

features.name: Expertise
features.description: Double your proficiency bonus for checks using two chosen skill proficiencies or thieves' tools.

features.name: Sneak Attack
features.description: Deal an extra 1d6 damage to one creature you hit with an attack if you have advantage or an ally is adjacent.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.description: Take a bonus action on each of your turns to Dash, Disengage, or Hide.

subclasses.name: Thief
subclasses.description: Hones skills in the larcenous arts of burglary and agility.

classes.name: Sorcerer
classes.description: A spellcaster who draws on inherent magic from a gift or bloodline.

features.name: Sorcerous Origin
features.description: Choose a magical origin, such as Draconic Bloodline or Wild Magic.

features.name: Font of Magic
features.description: Tap into an inner well of sorcery points to create spell slots or fuel Metamagic.

subclasses.name: Draconic Bloodline
subclasses.description: Infused with the primal draconic magic of dragon ancestors.

classes.name: Warlock
classes.description: A wielder of magic derived from a bargain with an otherworldly entity.

features.name: Otherworldly Patron
features.description: Strike a bargain with an otherworldly being such as The Fiend or The Archfey.

features.name: Pact Magic
features.description: Your spell slots are all of the same level and recharge on a short or long rest.

subclasses.name: The Fiend
subclasses.description: Bound to a lord of the Lower Planes of malice and fire.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: A scholarly magic-user capable of manipulating the structures of reality.

features.name: Arcane Recovery
features.description: Regain expended spell slots equal to half your wizard level after a short rest.

features.name: Spellbook
features.description: You possess a grimoire containing the arcane formulas for your spells.

subclasses.name: School of Evocation
subclasses.description: Focuses magic that creates powerful elemental effects.
